Comment.Language: Afrek t~ve is chanted after the reading of the Praxis and is to replace the Hymn of the Resurrection, Kata Ni,oroc and All you Heavenly Hosts:

A procession is done around the church three times venerating the icons of the Lord’s Resurrection and the Lord’s Ascension while chanting the hymn <~rictoc Anect/, followed by the Greek hymn for the Ascension, <~rictoc analum'ic:
At the end of the procession the Coptic hymn for the ascension is chanted:

Text.Language: Pi,~rictoc aftwnf e~bolqen n/eymwout: ouoh afsenaf e~p~swi e~ niv/oui~: afhemci caouinam m~Pefiwt qen n/et[oci: aferh~mot nan m~piwnq n~eneh.
Christ is risen from the dead and has ascended into the heavens, and is seated at the right hand of His Father in the highest, bestowing upon us everlasting life.
المسيح قام من الأموات وصعد إلي السموات، وجلس عن يمين أبيه في الأعالي وانعم لنا بالحياة الأبدية.

Comment.Language: Note that the Sunday after the Ascension is a Commemoration of the Resurrection, and so the procession is done only on Sunday, not all the ten days between Ascension and Pentecost.
From the Feast of the Ascension of our Lord to the 49th day of the Pentecost Period:

Text.Language: Pa[oic I/couc Pi,~rictoc: v/e~taftwnf e~bolqen n/eymwout: afsenaf e~p~swi eniv/oui: afhemci caouinam m~pefiwt
My Lord Jesus Christ, is risen from the dead, ascended into the heavens, and is seated at the right hand of His Father.
ياربي يسوع المسيح الذي قام من بين الأموات وصعد الي السموات وجلس عن يمين أبيه.
Euws e~bol eujw m~moc: je <~ouab ouoh <~ouab <~ouab P[oic n~nie~w~n <~rictouc Anect/ eknekrwn
cry out, saying, “Holy, holy, holy, Lord of the ages, Christ is risen from the dead.”
صارخين قائلين قدوس قدوس قدوس زب الدهور المسيح قام من الاموات.
